page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core).

The instance does not include bundled local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, relying on remote block storage for operating system and data retention needs. Additionally, it offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring explicit network configuration for external access.

Due to its high ratio of dedicated processing cores to system memory, the ecs.c2.large provides a compute-focused hardware profile. It is well suited for CPU-bound tasks such as software compilation, batch processing, static web serving infrastructure, and general compute workloads that do not demand extensive local disk space or high memory density.
